bridge-type.label: Dreame/MOVA Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to a Dreamehome or MOVAhome cloud account

parameter.name: cloudService
parameter.label: Cloud Service
parameter.description: Cloud service used by the account app

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Email address or phone number used by the selected app

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Account password used by the selected app

parameter.name: country
parameter.label: Country
parameter.description: Two-letter country code used by the account; European countries are automatically routed to the EU cloud

thing-type.label: Dreame/MOVA Robotic Mower
thing-type.description: A supported Dreame or MOVA robotic lawn mower

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: Device identifier reported by the selected cloud service

channel-type.label: Command

channel-type.description: Current proprietary Dreame device status or error code

channel-type.label: Do Not Disturb

channel-type.description: Current Bluetooth received signal strength

channel-type.description: Current LTE received signal strength

channel-type.description: Whether the mower reports its current work sequence as active

channel-type.description: Starts selective mowing. Send one or more existing positive zone IDs separated by commas, for example 1 or 1,2. IDs are validated against the active map.

channel-type.label: Cutting Height
channel-type.description: Map-wide cutting height in centimetres
